decisions: Use fixed FINAL_BEFORE_CLEAN history prediction state with four histories and four target optical cameras; no target RGB or sensor depth in projector.
Positive bilinear footprint determines candidacy only; hard minimum positive target-Z selects exact source RGB. Not weighted color fusion or a new method.
Freeze second_candidate_z as second item in complete stable sort; it may equal winner Z. Do not call it second distinct depth layer.
Read actual saved FP32 K/P values and promote to FP64; nominal 1.5u-96,1.5v relation is artificial same-camera check only.
Retain all source statuses, support candidates, losers, holes and four target outputs. Mask indicates predicted support, not correctness or ground-truth visibility.
remaining: Write isolated projector and explicit schema/source/resource/output contract.
Implement the three documented artificial fixtures plus boundary case, then different-author source review.
Only then run one fixed projection batch with complete receipts and independent saved-output check.
Freeze generation-consumer interface and G0/Gpaste/Gguide comparator separately; no choice of guide strength or denoising schedule has been tested here.
